title: test_claude_plugin_validate fails on main on every host whose claude CLI warns that the root CLAUDE.md is not loaded as project context, so every land gate selecting test_kb_mcp.py is red
goal: TestPluginManifest.test_claude_plugin_validate in _tools/test_kb_mcp.py names the warnings it allows, matched by their text and not by count: 'No version specified' and 'root: CLAUDE.md at the plugin root is not loaded as project context', and still fails on any other warning or on an error (a non-zero exit or no 'Validation passed'); the parsing is a pure helper so planted cases need no CLI: an unlisted warning fails, each allowed warning passes alone and together, an error fails; the real test still skips when no claude CLI is installed; CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md are not touched (whether the root CLAUDE.md should change is the operator's). Evidence: the local claude plugin validate printed the root CLAUDE.md warning about an hour after a gate that passed, and the test failed alone on main with only that warning beyond the version ones (found by TK-fsvrji77's land).
